items.stem: When preparing for the FINRA examination covered by this course, a candidate wants the single most reliable description of what the credential's knowledge domains require. Which statement best reflects sound preparation practice for the area 'Supervision of associated persons, hiring, qualification and continuing education'?

options.text: Study the current official content outline for this exam and map every in-scope objective before practising items
options.rationale: Correct: aligning study to the current official outline for the stated exam version is the sound basis for coverage; this course's domains are design assumptions pending that confirmation.

options.text: Rely only on recalled or 'dump' questions from previous test-takers
options.rationale: Incorrect and prohibited: recalled or leaked questions breach exam policy and do not reflect the current outline.

options.text: Assume the domain weightings never change between exam versions
options.rationale: Incorrect: issuers revise outlines and weightings; preparation must follow the current published version.

options.text: Skip the official outline and infer scope from a single third-party summary
options.rationale: Incorrect: a single unofficial summary can be incomplete or outdated relative to the official outline.

items.stem: A learner reviewing the area 'Supervision of general securities sales practices, accounts and customer disclosures' asks how this Mastemy preparation course relates to the official FINRA credential. Which statement is accurate?

options.text: Completing this course awards the official external credential automatically
options.rationale: Incorrect: the course awards only a Mastemy certificate of completion; the external credential is granted solely by the issuer.

options.text: This is independent preparation and does not award or guarantee the external credential
options.rationale: Correct: the course is independent preparation with no affiliation or endorsement, and does not confer the external credential or license.

options.text: The platform practice score predicts the official scaled exam score
options.rationale: Incorrect: platform scores are learning thresholds only and do not predict scaled external scores.

options.text: The course is officially endorsed by the issuer
options.rationale: Incorrect: no affiliation or endorsement is claimed or implied.

items.stem: Within the area 'Supervision of trading, operations, recordkeeping and regulatory compliance', which TWO of the following are appropriate, defensible practices? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Document the source and version basis for any claimed domain weighting
options.rationale: Correct: recording source and version basis keeps claims verifiable and honest when official weightings are not yet confirmed.

options.text: Treat an unverified design assumption as if it were a confirmed official fact
options.rationale: Incorrect: unverified assumptions must be labelled as such, not presented as confirmed fact.

options.text: Confirm scope against the current official outline before finalising coverage
options.rationale: Correct: confirming against the current official outline is the required step before treating coverage as complete.

options.text: Copy proprietary exam questions into the practice bank
options.rationale: Incorrect and prohibited: only original items may be used; proprietary or leaked questions are not permitted.
